translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: S'illotetsan Ayissiyaa Kaatiyaa
Be'ite, kaatii s'illotetsan kaatetana; mooddiyaawanttukka suuretetsan mooddana.
Asay huup'iyaan huup'iyaan c'arkkuwaappe geemmiyaa saa, gotiyaappe bak'atiyaa sa'aa gidanawaa; mela sa'aan goggiyaa haatsaanne zoozetiyaa gadiyaan de'iyaa wolk'k'aama zaallaa kuwaa mala gidanawaa.
S'eelliyaa asatuu ayfii c'iilimmenna; sisiyaawanttu haytsaykka hayzzana.
Tafitafiyaa asatuwaa wozanay erananne akeekana. Deeddotiyaa asatuwaa ins's'arssaykka suure geeshshiide haasayana.
Hawaappe sintsanaw eeyyi bonchcho asaa geetettenna. Iita Asay bonchchettenna.

Ayaw gooppe, boozay boozatetsaa haasaye; Aa wozanaykka nagaraa ootsanaw, Med'inaa Godaa bolla s'alabaa haasayanaw, koshshatteeddawantta kalissennan agganawunne saametteeddawantta ushshennan digganaw, iitabaa mak'ettee.
Uuzetiyaawaa uuzii iita; metootanchchay suurebaa haasayiide, wordduwaan hiyyeesaa d'ayissanaw I iita k'ofaa k'oppee.
Lo"o uray lo"obaa halchchee; he lo"o halchchuwan minniide de'ee.
Pirddaanne Betiyaappe Simmiyaawaa
Hinttenoo k'ofay bayinnan de'iyaa mac'c'awanttoo, denddite; ta odiyaawaa sisite; hinttenoo ammanettiide utteedda mac'c'a naatoo, taani hinttenttoo odiyaawaa sisite.
Itti laytsaappe guutsaa aad'd'ishshin, hintte ammanettiide utteeddawanttu kokkorana; woyniyaa Aa wodiyaan s'unk'k'iyaawe attana. Tookkeeddawaappe hintte ayfiyaa shiishshana wodiikka yeenna.
Hinttenoo ishaluwaan de'iyaa mac'c'awanttoo, kokkorite. Hinttenoo ammanettiide utteedda mac'c'a naatoo, gaji gajite. Hintte mayuwaa k'aarite; kayyuwaa afilaa hintte s'eessan danc'c'ite.
Lo"iyaa shoyk'aynne ayfiyaa dors's'os's'eedda woynnii d'ayeedda diraw, kayyottiidde, hintte tiraa bak'k'ite.
Aguntsaa buuraynne kinddichchuu ta asaa gaden mokkeedda. Asay nashettiide de'eedda golletuwaassinne nashshechchan de'eedda ha katamaw yeekkite.
Miis'ay attana; daro Asay de'iyaa katamatuukka onana; geessuunne wochchiyaa gimbbetuu med'inaw mela gidanawaa; unttunttu wora haretuu nashettiyaasaanne dorssaa wudii hamettiyaasaa gidanawaa.
Hewenne, bolla d'ok'k'aappe nu bolla ayyaanay gukkana gakkanaassa, mela bazzuu araddana gakkanaassanne aradda biittaykka wora gideedda geetettiide k'ofettana gakkanaassa.
Hewaappe guyyiyaan, suure pirdday mela bazzuwaan, s'illotetsaykka aradda gadiyaan de'ana.
S'illotetsaa oosuu sarotetsaa gidanawaa; s'illotetsaa ayifiikka med'inaw woppatetsaanne ammanettiide de'iyaawaa gidanawaa.
Ta Asay sarotetsay de'iyaa sa'aan, naagettiyaa golliyaaninne woppu geedda shemppo sa'atuwaan de'ana.
Shachchaan woray diippooppenne, k'ay katamay ubbaanna kolettooppenne,
he haatsaa ubbaa matan hintte katsaa zeriide, hintte mehiyaakka hintte haretuwaakka hentsaw billi yeddiide, hintte loytsi anjjettana.
